modalLead: Confetti is the new default look, with twenty-four colour-burst themes to go with it. Statistics gets a Server tab, a category can show tiles, and the keyboard shortcuts sheet is easier to search. A new install opens with a Quick start guide.

items.text: A quick start for a new install. After a moment a Quick start bar slides in at the bottom of the dashboard and opens a guide: what to do with the example links, your language, the weather and nine next steps. A new install also has ten example links waiting in the Inbox.
items.title: A quick start for a new install

media.alt: The Quick start guide open over the dashboard of a new install: what to do with the example links, the language, the weather and the first of the next steps

items.text: Confetti is the new default look. A fresh install starts on glass panes over a colour-burst backdrop, with masonry columns, Inter and larger type. Twenty-four new Looks join it, on three new backdrops: burst, splash and leak. Your dashboard keeps the theme it has; a one-time card lets you try Confetti and go back with one click.
items.title: Confetti and 24 new Looks

media.alt: The dashboard in Confetti: categories and widgets on glass over a colour-burst backdrop

items.text: Categories and widgets sit on glass, a card or nothing. Pick it under Surfaces, or let each theme bring its own.
Config and the list views are panes, drawn like the dashboard: the same glass, card or open.
Category headers start small. An install still on Medium moves to Small once; you can set it back under Rows.

Your server in Statistics. A new Server tab counts containers, updates, crashes, Docker disk use, Unraid disks, parity and VMs, and your automatic backups. Panels without a connection say what is missing.
items.title: Your server in Statistics

media.alt: Config, Statistics, Server tab: containers running, unhealthy and updates waiting, the Unraid array, resources now and the Unraid disks

items.text: Notifications on Health, and widgets by kind and per page on Collection.
A category can show tiles. Right-click its header and pick Show as tiles for a grid of large icons; Show as rows goes back.
Icons are part of a title. Type an emoji in a category or widget name, or use Insert icon… in the category menu.
The shortcuts sheet is easier to scan. Two columns, topic chips, and a filter that finds a key such as Shift+Y. Press / to jump to it.
Settings in a widget's menu opens just that widget's settings.
Space between columns is a setting of its own next to Space between categories: Snug, Balanced or Airy, under Appearance → Layout.
Surfaces from the palette. :surface, :effects, :widgetbg, :widgetopacity and :columngap change how it is drawn without opening config.
